summary: Converts an input value into whole seconds and a remainder: v8 = CRTFtol(a3 * 0.00027777778) is the truncated whole seconds written to *a1; the residual v7 = a3 - (double)v8 * 3600.0 is decomposed by FloatToIntConversionWithRemainder (0x005676C0) into the a2/a4 outputs, whose return value is propagated. The function reads two float globals at 0x0059E9B8 and 0x0059E9BC that do not surface as named operands in the inlined raw source.

operations.description: v8 = CRTFtol(a3 * 0.00027777778) — scale the input by 1/3600 and truncate to an integer count of whole seconds.
*a1 = v8 — write the whole-seconds result into the first output pointer.
v7 = a3 - (double)v8 * 3600.0 — remainder left over after removing the whole seconds.
return FloatToIntConversionWithRemainder(a2, a4, v7) — decompose the remainder into the two remaining outputs and propagate its return value.

unresolved: Read-only float globals flt_59E9B8 (0x0059E9B8) and flt_59E9BC (0x0059E9BC) are read but do not appear as named operands in the inlined raw source; they may hold the constants 0.00027777778 and 3600.0, but that mapping is unconfirmed.
Semantic meaning of the a2/a4 outputs produced by FloatToIntConversionWithRemainder (0x005676C0) is not confirmed.
